vocabulary.meaning: A statement considering what could have happened but did not

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक कथन जो इस पर विचार करता है कि क्या हो सकता था लेकिन नहीं हुआ
meaning_translation.Japanese: 実際には起こらなかったが、起こり得たことを考える表現

examples.sentence: A counterfactual thought: If I had studied harder, I would have passed.

translation.Hindi: एक वास्तविकता-विपरीत विचार: यदि मैंने अधिक पढ़ाई की होती, तो मैं पास हो जाता।
translation.Japanese: 反事実的な考え：もっと勉強していれば合格していただろう。

vocabulary.meaning: Imagining a situation or outcome that may not be real

meaning_translation.Hindi: ऐसी स्थिति या परिणाम की कल्पना करना जो वास्तविक नहीं हो सकता
meaning_translation.Japanese: 現実ではないかもしれない状況や結果を想定すること

examples.sentence: Hypothetical reasoning helps us plan for uncertain futures.

translation.Hindi: काल्पनिक तर्क हमें अनिश्चित भविष्य के लिए योजना बनाने में मदद करता है।
translation.Japanese: 仮定的な推論は、不確かな未来の計画に役立ちます。

vocabulary.meaning: A different version of events that could have occurred

meaning_translation.Hindi: घटनाओं का एक अलग संस्करण जो हो सकता था
meaning_translation.Japanese: 起こり得たかもしれない出来事の別のバージョン

examples.sentence: We explored an alternate scenario where the project failed.

translation.Hindi: हमने एक वैकल्पिक परिदृश्य की जांच की जहाँ परियोजना असफल हुई।
translation.Japanese: プロジェクトが失敗した場合の代替シナリオを検討しました。

vocabulary.meaning: A feeling of wishing you had done something differently

meaning_translation.Hindi: ऐसी भावना जिसमें आप चाहते हैं कि आपने कुछ अलग किया होता
meaning_translation.Japanese: 何かを違うようにしていればよかったという気持ち

examples.sentence: He felt regret for not taking the job opportunity.

translation.Hindi: उसे नौकरी के अवसर को न लेने का पछतावा हुआ।
translation.Japanese: 彼は仕事の機会を受けなかったことを後悔しました。

vocabulary.meaning: Ideas or guesses about what might have happened

meaning_translation.Hindi: विचार या अनुमान कि क्या हो सकता था
meaning_translation.Japanese: 何が起こったかもしれないという推測や考え

examples.sentence: There was speculation about how the story could have ended differently.

translation.Hindi: कहानी के अलग तरीके से समाप्त होने के बारे में अटकलें थीं।
translation.Japanese: 物語が別の結末を迎えたかもしれないという推測がありました。

vocabulary.meaning: The result of an action or event, especially when imagined

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी कार्य या घटना का परिणाम, विशेषकर जब कल्पना किया जाए
meaning_translation.Japanese: 特に想定した場合の行動や出来事の結果

examples.sentence: If they had acted sooner, the consequence would have been less severe.

translation.Hindi: यदि उन्होंने जल्दी कार्रवाई की होती, तो परिणाम कम गंभीर होता।
translation.Japanese: もし彼らが早く行動していたら、結果はそれほど深刻ではなかっただろう。

vocabulary.meaning: Stories exploring 'what if' scenarios beyond reality

meaning_translation.Hindi: 'क्या हो सकता है' की वास्तविकता से परे की कल्पना करने वाली कहानियाँ
meaning_translation.Japanese: 現実を超えた「もしも」を探求する物語

examples.sentence: Speculative fiction often explores alternate histories.

translation.Hindi: कल्पनात्मक कथा अक्सर वैकल्पिक इतिहास की खोज करती है।
translation.Japanese: 仮想小説はしばしば代替歴史を探求します。

vocabulary.meaning: An imagined version of the past that did not happen

meaning_translation.Hindi: अतीत का एक कल्पित संस्करण जो हुआ नहीं
meaning_translation.Japanese: 実際には起こらなかった過去の想像上のバージョン

examples.sentence: If she had taken the train, in that hypothetical past she’d have arrived on time.

translation.Hindi: यदि उसने ट्रेन ली होती, तो उस काल्पनिक अतीत में वह समय पर पहुंच जाती।
translation.Japanese: もし彼女が電車に乗っていれば、その仮定の過去では時間通りに着いていただろう。

vocabulary.meaning: A grammar structure to express imagined past situations (if + past perfect, would have + past participle)

meaning_translation.Hindi: अतीत की कल्पित स्थितियों को व्यक्त करने के लिए व्याकरण संरचना (if + past perfect, would have + past participle)
meaning_translation.Japanese: 起こらなかった過去の状況を表す文法構造 (if + past perfect, would have + 過去分詞)

examples.sentence: If I had known, I would have acted differently.

translation.Hindi: यदि मुझे पता होता, तो मैंने अलग तरीके से काम किया होता।
translation.Japanese: もし知っていたら、違う行動をしていただろう。

vocabulary.meaning: The spreading impact of a single change through many outcomes

meaning_translation.Hindi: एकल परिवर्तन का कई परिणामों में फैलने वाला प्रभाव
meaning_translation.Japanese: 一つの変化が多くの結果に波及する影響

examples.sentence: Changing one decision in history could create a huge ripple effect.

translation.Hindi: इतिहास में एक निर्णय बदलने से बड़ा तरंग प्रभाव हो सकता है।
translation.Japanese: 歴史の一つの決定を変えると大きな波及効果が生まれるかもしれません。

grammar_tips.title: Using the Third Conditional for Past Imaginations
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle' to describe unreal past scenarios (e.g., 'If I had studied, I would have passed').

explanation_translation.Hindi: अतीत की अवास्तविक स्थितियों को व्यक्त करने के लिए 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: 'If I had studied, I would have passed'.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 起こらなかった過去の状況を表すには「If + past perfect, would have + 過去分詞」を使います（例：If I had studied, I would have passed）。

grammar_tips.title: Speculative Connectors
grammar_tips.explanation: Use connectors like 'what if', 'suppose that', 'imagine if' to extend counterfactual scenarios creatively.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'what if', 'suppose that', 'imagine if' जैसे संयोजकों का उपयोग करके रचनात्मक रूप से वास्तविकता-विपरीत स्थितियों का विस्तार करें।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 「what if」「suppose that」「imagine if」などの接続詞を使って反事実的なシナリオを創造的に広げましょう。

grammar_tips.title: Exploring Ripple Effects
grammar_tips.explanation: Describe how one hypothetical change influences multiple future outcomes to show deeper reasoning.

explanation_translation.Hindi: यह बताएं कि एक काल्पनिक बदलाव कैसे कई भविष्य के परिणामों को प्रभावित करता है ताकि गहरी सोच दिखाई दे।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 一つの仮定の変化がどのように複数の将来の結果に影響するかを説明して、より深い推論を示しましょう。

vocabulary.question: Which term refers to an imagined situation that did not really happen?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा शब्द एक ऐसी कल्पित स्थिति को दर्शाता है जो वास्तव में नहीं हुई?
question_translation.Japanese: 実際には起こらなかった想像上の状況を指す用語はどれですか？

vocabulary.question: If she had studied more, she ___ passed the exam.

question_translation.Hindi: यदि उसने अधिक पढ़ाई की होती, तो वह परीक्षा ___ पास कर लेती।
question_translation.Japanese: もし彼女がもっと勉強していれば、試験に___合格していただろう。

vocabulary.question: A ripple effect describes how one change can spread to many outcomes.

question_translation.Hindi: तरंग प्रभाव बताता है कि कैसे एक बदलाव कई परिणामों तक फैल सकता है।
question_translation.Japanese: 波及効果とは、一つの変化が多くの結果に広がることを表します。

vocabulary.question: Which phrase signals speculation about unreal past events?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा वाक्यांश अवास्तविक अतीत की घटनाओं के बारे में अटकलों को दर्शाता है?
question_translation.Japanese: どのフレーズが起こらなかった過去の出来事についての推測を示しますか？

vocabulary.question: The story explored an alternate ___ where the war never happened.

question_translation.Hindi: कहानी ने एक वैकल्पिक ___ का पता लगाया जहाँ युद्ध कभी नहीं हुआ।
question_translation.Japanese: その物語は戦争が決して起こらなかった代替___を探求しました。

sentence.question: Arrange: [would, different, have, been, it, if, we, earlier, acted]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [would, different, have, been, it, if, we, earlier, acted]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [would, different, have, been, it, if, we, earlier, acted]

sentence.question: ___ if we had chosen another path?

question_translation.Hindi: यदि हमने कोई दूसरा रास्ता चुना होता तो ___?
question_translation.Japanese: もし別の道を選んでいたら___？

sentence.question: Choose the correct third conditional sentence:

question_translation.Hindi: सही तीसरी शर्त वाला वाक्य चुनें:
question_translation.Japanese: 正しい仮定法過去完了の文を選んでください:

options: If I knew, I would help you.
If I had known, I would have helped you.
If I know, I would have helped you.

sentence.question: Arrange: [different, would, have, outcome, the, been]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [different, would, have, outcome, the, been]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [different, would, have, outcome, the, been]

sentence.question: If she had taken the train, she ___ on time.

question_translation.Hindi: यदि उसने ट्रेन ली होती, तो वह समय पर ___।
question_translation.Japanese: もし彼女が電車に乗っていたら、時間通りに___。

listening.question: What is the speaker imagining?
listening.audio_text: If we had launched the product earlier, we might have dominated the market.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता क्या कल्पना कर रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を想像していますか？

options: Launching earlier could have led to market success

listening.question: The speaker is describing a real past event.
listening.audio_text: If I had taken the scholarship, my life would have changed completely.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता एक वास्तविक अतीत की घटना का वर्णन कर रहा है।
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は実際の過去の出来事を説明しています。

listening.question: What concept is shown by the speaker’s story?
listening.audio_text: Imagine if the internet had never been invented — our world would be unrecognizable.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता की कहानी कौन सी अवधारणा दिखाती है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者の話が示している概念は何ですか？

listening.question: What is the possible ripple effect mentioned?
listening.audio_text: If one scientist had published earlier, it could have sped up medical breakthroughs.

question_translation.Hindi: उल्लिखित संभावित तरंग प्रभाव क्या है?
question_translation.Japanese: 言及された可能性のある波及効果は何ですか？

listening.question: The speaker uses a hypothetical to explore an alternative past.
listening.audio_text: Suppose we had taken the northern route — we would have avoided the storm.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता एक वैकल्पिक अतीत का पता लगाने के लिए काल्पनिक का उपयोग करता है।
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は代替の過去を探るために仮定を使っています。

speaking.question: Say: 'If I had known earlier, I would have acted differently.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'If I had known earlier, I would have acted differently.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'If I had known earlier, I would have acted differently.'

speaking.answer: if i had known earlier i would have acted differently

speaking.question: Say: 'What if we had started the project last year?'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'What if we had started the project last year?'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'What if we had started the project last year?'

speaking.answer: what if we had started the project last year

speaking.question: Say: 'Imagine if the internet had never been invented.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Imagine if the internet had never been invented.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Imagine if the internet had never been invented.'

speaking.answer: imagine if the internet had never been invented

speaking.question: Say: 'If we had acted sooner, the consequences would have been lighter.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'If we had acted sooner, the consequences would have been lighter.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'If we had acted sooner, the consequences would have been lighter.'

speaking.answer: if we had acted sooner the consequences would have been lighter

speaking.question: Say: 'Suppose they had warned us before the event.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'Suppose they had warned us before the event.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'Suppose they had warned us before the event.'

speaking.answer: suppose they had warned us before the event
